examples.title: Basic shapes
examples.description: A QuickFunc that builds a shape from a type name, used for a circle and its label.

examples.title: Paths
examples.description: Straight, cubic and arc path commands, filled and stroked.

examples.title: Text
examples.description: A gradient title, bold and regular text, accents and the three text anchors.

examples.title: Text styles
examples.description: Letter spacing, underline, overline and line-through, and italic and oblique text.

examples.title: Stroke styles
examples.description: Dash arrays, line caps and line joins, with the true ends of the strokes marked.

examples.title: Groups and use
examples.description: One group built once and drawn six times with use.

examples.title: Parametric badges
examples.description: Badges built by a QuickFunc that returns a group, called with different labels and colors.

examples.title: Gradients
examples.description: Two linear gradients and a radial gradient on rectangles and a circle.

examples.title: Gradient gallery
examples.description: Linear, radial and conic gradients on rectangles and circles.

examples.title: Gradient spread
examples.description: pad, reflect and repeat on the same gradient, and a radial gradient that repeats in rings.

examples.title: Gradient units and transform
examples.description: A user-space gradient shared by a circle, a rect and a line, and a repeating stripe gradient turned by a transform.

examples.title: Radial focal point and fr
examples.description: A focal point inside and outside the circle, and fr as a ring and larger than r.

examples.title: Fill and stroke opacity
examples.description: fill_opacity and stroke_opacity fade one channel each, over a light band.

examples.title: Blend modes
examples.description: Eight blend modes on the same circle over the same gradient.

examples.title: Layer effects
examples.description: blur, drop shadow, inner shadow, outer glow and inner glow on one circle.
examples.note: The GPU renderer draws only the blur. This preview is the SVG renderer, which draws all five.

examples.title: Color filters
examples.description: feColorMatrix and the CSS color functions as layer effects, plus a blur with a different amount per axis. Needs wire version 3.

examples.title: Filter graph
examples.description: feFlood, feComposite, feMerge, feBlend and feComponentTransfer as one graph effect: duotone, posterize, tint, a cast shadow and a negative. Needs wire version 3.
examples.note: The GPU renderer does not draw a graph yet. This preview is the SVG renderer.

examples.title: Clip path and mask
examples.description: A layer cut by a clip path, and a layer faded by a luminance mask.

examples.title: Layers: opacity swap
examples.description: Two overlapping layers that trade places by animating opacity.

examples.title: Layers: z_index swap
examples.description: Two layers whose paint order really swaps over time through z_index.

examples.title: Orbit and pulse
examples.description: A wobbling box and a dot that moves, scales and fades with eased keyframes.

examples.title: Loader dots
examples.description: A three-dot loader with delayed, repeating scale and opacity, made by importing an SVG.

examples.title: Clock
examples.description: A time-lapse clock with two rotating hands, made by importing an SVG.

examples.title: Motion path
examples.description: An arrow that follows a curve and turns with it, and a square that ping-pongs, made by importing animateMotion.

examples.title: Set, visibility and steps
examples.description: Elements that appear on a set, a blinking dot and a bar that fills in five jumps, made by importing SVG.

examples.title: Color cycle
examples.description: Fill colors that cycle, shifted by a negative begin, and a stroke width that pulses. Needs wire version 3.

examples.title: Dash draw
examples.description: A ring and a rectangle that draw their outline with a dash offset while the stroke color changes. Needs wire version 3.

examples.title: Dots in a ring
examples.description: Three dots that start each other with begin values that name other animations, repeating on a 1.55 s ring. Needs wire version 3.

examples.title: Equalizer bars
examples.description: Bars whose height and top edge animate together, each starting a fixed time after the first. Needs wire version 3.

examples.title: Ring with a moving dash
examples.description: A ring with an animated dash array, a color that changes and a rotation. Needs wire version 3.

examples.title: SDF shapes
examples.description: Signed distance primitives and their boolean operations, with smooth blending.

examples.title: SDF logo
examples.description: The letters M, S and X built from SDF primitives, lit by splats.

examples.title: SDF and splats together
examples.description: Hard vector shapes, SDF booleans and Gaussian splat atmosphere in one scene.

examples.title: SDF and splats, animated
examples.description: The mixed scene with a splat bloom that breathes in step with the SDF blob.

examples.title: Splat atmosphere
examples.description: Gaussian splats as soft, additive glowing ellipses.

examples.title: Splat with a gradient fill
examples.description: A Gaussian splat filled by a gradient reference.

examples.title: Shader: plasma
examples.description: A shape filled by a WGSL plasma shader.
examples.note: Shader fills run in the GPU renderer. This preview is the SVG renderer, which draws the shape without the shader.

examples.title: Shader: checkerboard
examples.description: A diagnostic checkerboard shader on a shape.
examples.note: Shader fills run in the GPU renderer. This preview is the SVG renderer, which draws the shape without the shader.

examples.title: Shader: raymarched orb
examples.description: A raymarched, rim-lit orb from a WGSL shader.
examples.note: Shader fills run in the GPU renderer. This preview is the SVG renderer, which draws the shape without the shader.

examples.title: Shader fills inside a layer
examples.description: Shader fills on a shape, an SDF node and a splat that sit inside a layer.
examples.note: Shader fills run in the GPU renderer. This preview is the SVG renderer, which draws the shape without the shader.

examples.title: SDF with a shader fill
examples.description: A shader masked to the true silhouette of an SDF node.
examples.note: Shader fills run in the GPU renderer. This preview is the SVG renderer, which draws the shape without the shader.

examples.title: Splat with a shader fill
examples.description: A shader masked to the falloff of a Gaussian splat.
examples.note: Shader fills run in the GPU renderer. This preview is the SVG renderer, which draws the shape without the shader.

examples.title: Image and audio
examples.description: Embedded and referenced images, and an audio def.
examples.note: Audio is not played here, and an image that is a file path cannot be read by the browser.

examples.title: QR code
examples.description: A QR code drawn with paths and rectangles by the mid-qr generator.
